verdict.rationale: Relay's docs clearly support opening up to 20 checking sub-accounts (including Profit-First style nicknaming) and automating transfers across them by dollar amount or percentage, and community evidence corroborates the auto-partitioning behavior in practice. missing for 10: independent verification of allocation reliability/edge cases (e.g., failed or delayed auto-transfers) and more detail on configuring percentage-based rules beyond marketing copy.
